name: multiregion-web
description: Azure Front Door Premium + WAF routing to App Service backends in two regions, backed by multi-region Cosmos DB with automatic failover.
what: A global Front Door profile with a managed WAF fronts two regional App Service deployments. Front Door health-probes both origins and load-balances across them; each web app accepts traffic only from Front Door (service tag + x-azure-fdid header). Cosmos DB replicates across both regions with automatic failover, optionally with multi-region writes.
why: Business-critical web workloads need to survive a regional outage and serve users with low latency worldwide. This template delivers an active-active footprint with a single global anycast entry point, automated failover, and origin lockdown - the standard mission-critical web pattern.
potentialUseCases: Mission-critical customer portal with an availability SLO
Global e-commerce storefront needing low latency per geography
Regulated workload requiring regional resilience and DR
Public API needing global WAF and DDoS protection

reliability: Active-active App Service in two regions behind Front Door
Cosmos DB multi-region with automatic failover
security: Front Door managed WAF (DRS 2.1) in Prevention mode
Origins locked to Front Door via service tag + x-azure-fdid header
HTTPS-only end to end with HTTP-to-HTTPS redirect
costOptimization: Standard Front Door and single-instance P0v3 in dev
Single-write Cosmos in dev; multi-write only in prod
operationalExcellence: Shared Application Insights / Log Analytics across regions
Region surfaced to the app via configuration for observability
performanceEfficiency: Anycast edge routing sends users to the nearest healthy origin
Front Door caching and connection offload at the edge

cost.profile: Prod profile: Premium Front Door, P1v3 x3 in two regions, multi-region Cosmos.

components.name: App Service Plan primary (P1v3 x3)
components.notes: Three instances in the primary region.

components.name: App Service Plan secondary (P1v3 x3)
components.notes: Three instances in the secondary region.

components.name: Cosmos DB multi-region (provisioned RU)
components.notes: ~1000 RU/s replicated across two regions (2 x 730h x 10 units).
